title: Info panel per underlying: lot size, ATM strike, expiries, contract specifications (G-01-2)
reference_behaviour: An Info panel per underlying shows price, open-high-low-close, expiry, monthly futures, a derivatives data tab (lot size, ATM strike, put-call ratio, ATM IV, max pain, IV percentile, volatility index), events and a contract specifications link.
ours: NEW AC NEEDED: no Info drawer; lot size appears only after a contract is chosen. REQ-139 (header) is the closest; REQ-106 covers ATM IV, PCR, max pain, VIX.
